February 8, 1933.

CONFIDENTIAL

Sir,

Ernest William Weekes

I have the honour to refer to your letter W.108/32
and enclosures of December 3, 1932, and to inform you that
E.W. Weekes arrived in Shanghai in the latter part of the
year 1921 under the name of Lionel W. Weekes. He secured
employment, through the United Services Association, with
the Shanghai-Hongkew Wharf Company as general overseer,
which position he held until March 9, 1923, when he joined
the Shanghai Fire Brigade as a Sub-Officer, resigning on
March 25, 1925. He then obtained employment with Holts
Wharf, where he remained for about five months when he left
Shanghai suddenly informing only a few friends of his
intention on the day of his departure. During his stay in
Shanghai he was never known to represent himself as a doctor.
He was, however, a very plausible man and succeeded in leaving
this city owing considerable amounts of money to various
tradespeople.

Weekes was known to have visited Australia and in 1927
a full page article appeared in an Australian paper, entitled
"SmithsWeekly" regarding his fraudulent activities in
Melbourne. In this connection I would suggest that you
communicate with the Chief of Police in Melbourne.
（此处转录不清）

先生，

欧内斯特·威廉·威克斯（Ernest William Weekes）

谨此提及阁下1932年12月3日的W.108/32号信函及附件，并告知阁下，E.W. 威克斯于1921年下半年以莱昂内尔·W·威克斯（Lionel W. Weekes）之名抵达上海。他通过联合服务协会（United Services Association）在上海虹口码头公司（Shanghai-Hongkew Wharf Company）谋得总监工一职，任职至1923年3月9日，随后加入上海救火会担任副官，于1925年3月25日辞职。此后他在霍尔茨码头（Holts Wharf）受雇，在此工作约五个月后突然离开上海，仅在离境当日告知少数几位朋友其去向。他在上海期间，从未有人知晓他曾自称医生。然而，他是一个极善言辞的人，成功离开了本市，但欠下了许多商人的巨额债务。

据悉威克斯曾访问澳大利亚，1927年澳大利亚报纸《史密斯周刊》（Smiths Weekly）刊登了一篇关于他在墨尔本进行欺诈活动的整版文章。鉴于此，我建议阁下与墨尔本警察局长联系。
（此处转录不清）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. D 4136

REPORT
H. Q. Crime Branch Station,
Date February 8, 1933

Subject (in full) Ernest William Meeks alias Lionel A. Meekes alias Edwin
William Meekes.

Made by D.I. Sharman Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,
Inquiries at the Shanghai Hongkew wharf re Meeker, elicit
that he arrived in Shanghai in the latter part of 1921 and was
known as Lionel A. Meekes. Through the offices of the United
Services Association he was found employment in the Shanghai
Hongkew Wharf Company as Warehouse and general overseer. He
continued in this employment until March 9th, 1925 when he joined
the Shanghai Fire Brigade as a Sub-Officer. He resigned this
position on March 25th, 1925, and obtained employment with Holts
Wharf. This position he held for about five months, when he
suddenly left Shanghai, telling only a few friends on the day of
his departure that he was leaving. During his stay in Shanghai
he was never known to represent himself as a doctor, he was how-
ever a very plausible man, and succeeded in leaving Shanghai
owing considerable amounts to various tradespeople. He was known
to have visited Australia, and he was subject of a full page
article in an Australian paper "Smiths Weekly" in 1927 showing
how he had duped the Melbourne people, by means of a faked letter,
to show that he had inherited a fortune in England, which he used
to obtain extensive credit. A copy of this paper is not available
here, but verification could easily be obtained from the paper
itself, as this article was seen by several local people. It is
not known if police action was taken, but Meekes succeeded in
leaving Australia before he was found out.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

〔此处转录不清：签名及缩写 D. I.〕

D.C. (Crime)

日期 1933年2月8日

主题（全称）欧内斯特·威廉·米克斯（Ernest William Meeks），又名莱昂内尔·A·米克斯（Lionel A. Meekes），又名埃德温·威廉·米克斯（Edwin William Meekes）。

由侦探督察沙曼（Sharman）制作，由警司奎尔（Quayle）转呈

先生，
经向上海虹口码头查询有关米克（Meeker）的情况，获悉他于1921年下半年抵达上海，当时名为莱昂内尔·A·米克斯（Lionel A. Meekes）。通过联合服务协会的介绍，他在上海虹口码头公司找到了一份仓库及总监工的工作。他一直从事该工作直至1925年3月9日，随后加入上海救火会担任副官。他于1925年3月25日辞去该职务，并在霍尔茨码头（Holts Wharf）受雇。该职位他担任了约五个月，随后突然离开上海，仅在离境当日告知少数几位朋友他要离开。他在上海期间，从未有人知晓他曾自称医生，但他是一个极善言辞的人，成功离开了上海，但欠下了许多商人的巨额债务。据悉他曾访问澳大利亚，1927年澳大利亚报纸《史密斯周刊》（Smiths Weekly）刊登了一篇关于他的整版文章，显示他如何通过一封伪造的信件欺骗墨尔本民众，声称他在英国继承了一笔遗产，并以此获得大量信贷。此处无法提供该报纸的副本，但很容易从报社本身核实，因为当地有数人见过这篇文章。不知警方是否采取了行动，但米克斯在被识破前成功离开了澳大利亚。

先生，
您顺从的，

〔此处转录不清：签名及缩写 D. I.〕

刑事科副督察

page_data.en:
COPY.

Ernest William Weekes States,

I am a British subject and was born at
Toronto, Canada, on the 8th January, 1888. Both my
parents are dead. My father, William King Weekes, was
a Medical Practitioner and died when I was about 11 years
of age. He died in Toronto. My mother, Edith Weekes,
died about a year after my father. After my parents'
death I lived with an Aunt, Mrs. Winifred Griffis in
Toronto. When I reached the age of 16 years I went to
the Western University, London, Ontario, to study for
medicine. I was here for about five years but failed to
qualify. About June 1914 I left Canada and went to England
on a trip. I remained in England until War was declared and
enlisted in the 2nd 5th Gloucester Regiment as a private.
I went to France where I remained until the middle of
1916, returned to England and went over to Ireland, remained
there for four months and came back to England. I was
then transferred to the Royal Scots and went to France
with them until the end of the War. Early part of 1919
I returned to Canada and went back to the Western
University, London, Ontario, where I qualified as a
M.D. I qualified in 1920 and received my diploma,
which I subsequently sent to my mother's parents in
Gloucester, England. I have no idea where it is now, but
it is possible that my brother, Frederick George Weekes,
has it in his possession. The last time I heard of him
was about three years ago, when I met him in England.

After I qualified I left Canada and went
to Japan visiting the various Towns on a holiday trip.
I remained in Japan about five months and then went
Vladivostok, Russia, with the intention of joining
with the White Army. I served with this Army
medical man, for about four months, and was
**〔此处转录不清〕**
page_data.zh:
副本。

欧内斯特·威廉·威克斯陈述如下：

我是英国臣民，1888年1月8日出生于加拿大多伦多。双亲均已去世。父亲威廉·金·威克斯（William King Weekes）是一名执业医师，在我约11岁时去世。他死于多伦多。母亲伊迪丝·威克斯（Edith Weekes）在父亲去世后约一年去世。父母去世后，我与姑母温妮弗雷德·格里菲斯（Winifred Griffis）夫人在多伦多同住。年满16岁时，我前往安大略省伦敦市的西部大学（Western University）学医。我在那里待了约五年，但未取得资格。1914年6月左右，我离开加拿大前往英国旅行。我在英国停留至宣战，随后以列兵身份入伍，加入格洛斯特郡团第2/5营（2nd 5th Gloucester Regiment）。我前往法国，在那里待到1916年中，返回英国后前往爱尔兰，在那里停留了四个月，然后回到英国。随后我被调往皇家苏格兰团（Royal Scots），并随该团前往法国直至战争结束。1919年初，我返回加拿大，回到安大略省伦敦市的西部大学，在那里取得了医学博士（M.D.）资格。我于1920年获得资格并收到文凭，随后将其寄给了我在英国格洛斯特的外祖父母。我不知道文凭现在何处，但可能由我的兄弟弗雷德里克·乔治·威克斯（Frederick George Weekes）保管。我最后一次听到他的消息大约是三年前，当时我在英国与他见面。

取得资格后，我离开加拿大前往日本，在各城镇进行假日旅行。我在日本停留了约五个月，然后前往俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），意图加入白军。我在这支军队中担任医务人员约四个月，并
**〔此处转录不清〕**

page_data.en:
(2)

expelled from Russia by the Red Authorities. I was
sent to Shanghai. This would be about the latter part
of 1921. Whilst in Shanghai I opened a practice and was
associated with the Shanghai Municipal Fire Brigade.
I remained here until February, 1926, and received a
reference from the Chief Officer of the Fire Brigade
of Shanghai, which I produce. From 1926 to about the
middle of 1927 I visited Singapore, Hong Kong, Malacca,
Penang, British North Borneo, Java, Thursday Island,
Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane. I was not practising during
these visits. It was more of a holiday trip. I left
Australia and went to France; I was in France for about
five months and crossed to England. This was then about
the middle of 1928. I spent three months in London and
then went to Rio de Janeiro, South America. I obtained
employment with the Sao Paulo Tramway, Light and Power
Company, Limited, as the Company's Doctor. I remained
here until November, 1929, and produce a reference from
this Company.

The Passport I was in possession of at
this time had been destroyed by fire which occurred at
the Hospital just outside Sao Paulo. My name on this
Passport was Edwin William Weekes, which is my correct
name. I applied for a new one at the Consulate at Sao
Paulo by writing for it enclosing a letter from the
Tramway, Light and Power Company, Limited. I collected
the passport in Sao Paulo on my way to Santos. I did not
examine it at that time, but after leaving Santos for
South Africa I found that my first Christian name had
been put down as Ernest. This must have been a mistake
by the Consulate. I arrived in South Africa on the
3rd December 1929 at Cape Town. It was my intention
**〔此处转录不清〕**
page_data.zh:
(2)

被红色政权当局驱逐出俄罗斯。我被送往上海。这大约是1921年下半年。在上海期间，我开设了诊所，并与上海公共租界工部局救火会有关联。我在此停留至1926年2月，并获得了上海救火会总队长的推荐信，现予出示。从1926年至1927年中，我访问了新加坡、香港、马六甲、槟城、英属北婆罗洲、爪哇、星期四岛、悉尼、墨尔本、布里斯班。在这些访问期间，我并未行医。这更像是一次假日旅行。我离开澳大利亚前往法国；我在法国停留了约五个月，然后渡海前往英国。这大约是1928年中。我在伦敦度过了三个月，然后前往南美洲的里约热内卢。我在圣保罗电车、照明及电力有限公司（Sao Paulo Tramway, Light and Power Company, Limited）受雇，担任公司医生。我在此停留至1929年11月，并出示该公司的推荐信。

当时我持有的护照已在圣保罗郊外医院发生的一场火灾中被毁。该护照上的名字是埃德温·威廉·威克斯（Edwin William Weekes），这是我的真名。我写信向圣保罗领事馆申请新护照，并附上了电车、照明及电力有限公司的一封信。我在前往桑托斯（Santos）途中在圣保罗领取了护照。当时我没有检查，但在离开桑托斯前往南非后，我发现我的教名被写成了欧内斯特（Ernest）。这一定是领事馆的错误。我于1929年12月3日抵达南非开普敦。我打算
**〔此处转录不清〕**

page_data.en:
(3)

to proceed to England after staying for about a month.
During this month I became acquainted with my present
wife, whom I married at the Magistrate's Court at Cape
Town. My wife had two children when I married her. I
did not practice in Cape Town, neither did I register myself
in the Union as a Medical Practitioner. I remained in Cape
Town from December 1929 to October 1932, my address being
21 Mill Street. I left Cape Town in October by car
accompanied by my wife and child Norman, aged 9 years, and
went to Kimberley, where I stayed with a friend, Francis
Pope, who is one of the Magistrates there. I remained
with him for ten days and then came to Johannesburg. In
Johannesburg I met my brother-in-law, Edgar Olley, and it was
arranged that he should accompany us to Rhodesia. Whilst
in Johannesburg I was staying at the Berkeley Hotel. I
obtained a permit from the Electoral Officer in Johannesburg
for a journey to Portuguese East Africa. We left
Johannesburg together and went to Stegi, Swaziland, where I
spent most of my time between Stegi and Lorenzo Marques.
I stayed on the Bar R. Ranch, Stegi, for about six weeks.
This ranch belongs to Reece Evans. I left Stegi and
arrived in Southern Rhodesia on the 30th November, 1932,
via Beitbridge. I was met at Beitbridge by an Official who
I took to be the Customs Officer. I signed two forms there
but have recollection of filling in the one now shown to
me (Form 118). I came to Rhodesia on a visit to my
brother-in-law, Charles Olley, of Salisbury. It is my
intention to stay here for a couple of months, and then
return to England either via Union of South Africa or
India.

I have approximately the sum of £15 cash
in my possession. I have a banking account with the
Standard Bank at Cape Town, current account, and the usual
**〔此处转录不清〕**
page_data.zh:
(3)

停留约一个月后前往英国。在这一个月期间，我结识了现在的妻子，并在开普敦地方法院与她结婚。我娶她时，她已有两个孩子。我在开普敦没有行医，也没有在南非联邦注册为执业医师。我从1929年12月至1932年10月居住在开普敦，地址是米尔街21号。10月，我驾车离开开普敦，随行有妻子和9岁的儿子诺曼（Norman），前往金伯利，在那里借住在一位朋友弗朗西斯·波普（Francis Pope）家中，他是当地的地方法官之一。我在他家住了十天，然后来到约翰内斯堡。在约翰内斯堡，我遇到了我的妹夫埃德加·奥利（Edgar Olley），并商定由他陪同我们前往罗得西亚。在约翰内斯堡期间，我住在伯克利酒店（Berkeley Hotel）。我从约翰内斯堡的选举官员那里获得了前往葡属东非洲的许可证。我们一起离开约翰内斯堡，前往斯威士兰的斯特吉（Stegi），我的大部分时间在斯特吉和洛伦索马克斯（Lorenzo Marques）之间度过。我在斯特吉的巴尔R牧场（Bar R. Ranch）停留了约六周。该牧场属于里斯·埃文斯（Reece Evans）。我离开斯特吉，经贝特布里奇（Beitbridge）于1932年11月30日抵达南罗得西亚。在贝特布里奇，一位官员接待了我，我以为他是海关官员。我在那里签署了两份表格，但对填写现在出示给我的那份表格（118号表格）已无印象。我来罗得西亚是为了探望我在索尔兹伯里（Salisbury）的妹夫查尔斯·奥利（Charles Olley）。我打算在此停留两个月，然后经南非联邦或印度返回英国。

我手头约有15英镑现金。我在开普敦的标准银行（Standard Bank）有一个活期账户，以及通常的
**〔此处转录不清〕**

page_data.en:
(4)

standing to my credit there is about £700. I wrote to
the Standard Bank in Cape Town on Tuesday asking them
to transfer the sum of £200 to Mr. Charles Olley, my
brother-in-law, and the balance to be transferred to the
London Joint City and Midland Bank, London. I still have
a current account with this bank.

My wife has a private income of her
own. I do not know the amount she has. We were married
by Antenuptial Contract. The car we came to Rhodesia with
is the property of my wife. It was given to her as a wedding
present.

I am registered as a Medical Practitioner
in the British Medical Association of the United Kingdom.
I am registered in the name of Edwin William Weekes, which
is my correct name. My diploma received from the Western
University, London, Ontario, is also in this name.

The only relation I have living is my
brother, Frederick George Weekes. I have no idea where
he is at the present time. I have no friends in the
medical profession in the Union of South Africa or
Rhodesia. I am well known to Doctor Abel Vargas who is,
as far as I know, with the Tramway, Light and Power Company,
Limited, Sao Paulo, Brazil. He would be the person to
vouch for my credentials.

When I left France in 1918 I went to
Ireland on Home Service. This was after completing 18
months active service in France, and it was whilst I was
in Ireland that I was transferred to the Royal Scots. I
received my discharges from the Army on demobilisation at
Edinburgh Castle, Scotland. I have not seen them for some
years now and it is possible that they have been mislaid
or lost.

I produce...
page_data.zh:
(4)

我名下约有 700 英镑存款。我于周二致信开普敦的标准银行（Standard Bank），请他们将 200 英镑汇给我的妹夫查尔斯·奥利先生（Mr. Charles Olley），余款汇至伦敦的伦敦联合城市与米德兰银行（London Joint City and Midland Bank, London）。我在该银行仍有一个活期账户。

我的妻子有她自己的私人收入。我不知道她有多少钱。我们是依据婚前契约结婚的。我们来到罗得西亚时乘坐的汽车是我妻子的财产。那是作为结婚礼物送给她的。

我在英国医学会（British Medical Association of the United Kingdom）注册为执业医师。我以埃德温·威廉·威克斯（Edwin William Weekes）之名注册，这是我的正确姓名。我从安大略省伦敦市的西部大学（Western University, London, Ontario）获得的文凭也是用这个名字。

我目前在世的亲属只有我的兄弟弗雷德里克·乔治·威克斯（Frederick George Weekes）。我不知道他目前身在何处。我在南非联邦或罗得西亚的医学界没有朋友。阿贝尔·瓦尔加斯医生（Doctor Abel Vargas）对我很熟悉，据我所知，他在巴西圣保罗的电车、照明与电力有限公司（Tramway, Light and Power Company, Limited, Sao Paulo, Brazil）任职。他将是为我的资历作保的人选。

1918 年我离开法国后，前往爱尔兰从事本土服役。这是在法国完成 18 个月现役之后，而在我身处爱尔兰期间，我被调往皇家苏格兰团（Royal Scots）。我在苏格兰爱丁堡城堡退伍时获得了军队的退役证明。我已经多年未见这些文件，它们可能被放错地方或遗失了。

我出示……

page_data.en:
(5)

I produce Passport number 973 issued to me
by the Consul General of Sao Paulo, Brazil, on the 29th
August 1929. In this it shows the date of my birth to
be the 8th January, 1891, which is not correct. This may
have been a mistake of mine when applying for it.

sgd. Edwin William Weekes.

Salisbury. 1.12.32.
Before me;
sgd. H. Beacord.
Det.Sgt.

Further states

I can produce no further papers or documents
in regard to my identity.

I have seen the Medical Register of 1929
wherein it appears a person named William Edwin Weekes,
Master, Ont; Canada, 1881, May 1920, M.C.P. & S., Ont.1920
M.D. Western U. Ont. 1926. I have also seen the Medical
Directory of 1931 wherein it appears a person named William
Edwin Weekes, Master, Ont; Canada, M.C.P.S. Ont. 1920.
M.D. Western Uni; Ont; 1920 (West; Univ; Med; Sch;), Coroner,
Huron County. I can definitely say that both refer to
myself. I cannot give any explanation as to why my name
should appear as William Edwin Weekes, when my correct name
is Edwin William Weekes. I cannot explain why the Medical
Directory 1931 should still show that I am still the
Coroner of Huron County, when I have been absent from Canada
for the past 11 years. Although I applied for this position
and was accepted, I did not commence duties as I left
Canada for the East.

I did not register myself as a Medical
Practitioner. This was done by the Registrar of the
Western University, Ontario. It was after I had obtained
my degree and left the University that I was registered,
page_data.zh:
(5)

我出示由巴西圣保罗总领事于 1929 年 8 月 29 日签发给我的第 973 号护照。其中显示我的出生日期为 1891 年 1 月 8 日，这并不正确。这可能是我在申请时的失误。

签名：埃德温·威廉·威克斯。

索尔兹伯里。1932 年 12 月 1 日。
在我面前；
签名：H. Beacord。
警佐

进一步陈述

我无法提供关于我身份的更多文件或证件。

我已查阅 1929 年的《医疗登记册》，其中显示有一人名叫威廉·埃德温·威克斯（William Edwin Weekes），硕士，安大略省；加拿大，1881 年生，1920 年 5 月获安大略省内外科医师执照（M.C.P. & S., Ont.1920），1926 年获安大略省西部大学医学博士（M.D. Western U. Ont. 1926）。我也查阅了 1931 年的《医疗名录》，其中显示有一人名叫威廉·埃德温·威克斯（William Edwin Weekes），硕士，安大略省；加拿大，1920 年获安大略省内外科医师执照（M.C.P.S. Ont. 1920），1920 年获安大略省西部大学医学博士（M.D. Western Uni; Ont; 1920 (West; Univ; Med; Sch;)），休伦县验尸官。我可以肯定地说，这两处指的都是我自己。我无法解释为何我的名字会显示为威廉·埃德温·威克斯，而我的正确姓名是埃德温·威廉·威克斯。我也无法解释为何 1931 年的《医疗名录》仍显示我是休伦县的验尸官，尽管我在过去 11 年里一直不在加拿大。虽然我申请了这一职位并被录用，但我并未开始履行职责，因为我离开加拿大前往东方。

我没有自行注册为执业医师。这是由安大略省西部大学的注册主任办理的。据我回忆，在我获得学位并离开大学后才进行了注册，

page_data.en:
(6)

as far as I can recollect at that time I was residing
at the University or Wardsville, Ontario. Since the
time I was registered I have never communicated with the
Registrar of the Medical Register or Directory giving them
my various changes of addresses.

Salisbury. 1.12.32.                          sgd.   E.W. Weekes.
